explanation: From main: vite.config.ts gates VitePWA on VITE_SERVICE_WORKER (selfDestroying when unset, full Workbox config kept for opt-in); deploy:cf and deploy:cf:dry run build instead of deploy:dist, so precompress is now Apache-only; verify_deploy treats the app sidecar yardstick as optional on the edge model, and the delivery, development, guidance and release docs and catalog describe this. From the mobile pass: index.html keeps the hub bar from shrinking under the beta notice at 320px and puts the phone hub nav on one sideways-scrolling line beside the compare pill; the UI-change runbook records the explorer breadcrumb's phone layout and its 1500px breakpoint. From the listing-toggle work: the catalog's statistics area names the shared FDR / p < 0.05 listing toggle and references listingModeStore.ts, the generated AGENTS.md map line follows it, and the UI-change runbook names the listing mode, TierLabel and QTerm as the shared pieces for significance tables. From the nSig branch: CONTEXT.md's Bundle-writer seam bullet now states the nSig rule as finite FDR < 0.05, matching the QC heading and the app's significance call, instead of nominal P < 0.01; the geo, batch2 and normalized builders log the FDR count. From the changelog branch: CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased note records that the website changelog now covers the public release and PRs #1-#46, including the FDR nSig counts now published. Repository structure and commands are unchanged.
